searchText: What's the current status-quo on setting `safeBlockHash`? LH has it set to the head block, as per some old specifications. My understanding is that the "safe head" was something that the research team *thought* they had figured out but then it turned to be more complex than originally considered. My feeling is that if we're communicating something to be "safe" and we don't have a definition of what "safe" means, then we should use the finalized checkpoint. cc <@425572898787426305> the latest spec specifies to use justified checkpoint: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2858 Oh thanks, I didn't even realise this `safe_block` spec existed! First rule of Ethereum - there's always another spec, in another repo, mentioned on a different chat room. 🙂 Actually, this safe block spec is linked from the Bellatrix fork choice spec. Though, I admit that this link is kinda lost among other statements The status quo is to use justified as a safe block as its quite safe from re-orgs and is used as initial checkpoint for the safe algorithm that we have. Once the algorithm is improved we will upgrade `get_safe_beacon_block_root` function to return a block that is closer to the head Ropsten beacon chain config PR was merged today: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/pull/9 Please have a look again, some information such as config name, genesis delay and genesis.ssz were changed since the PR was opened. So please do make sure you've the right files included in your releases. Additionally TTD has been updated for mainnet-shadow-fork-5, its expected to hit ~3PM CEST tomorrow. New TTD value: `49399410637657203539968` Link to configs: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-5 Hey Folks, I'm currently working on adding the rest of the CL clients to hive to test the EL mock that Marius wrote, I'm working on adding Teku currently, <@340345049063882753> is there any discord channel I could use to report issues/get support or feedback ? The Teku channel on the ConsenSys server is the ideal place: https://discord.gg/vfHTvsV does geth master more changes to support the Merge on Ropsten, or is what's in master enough?

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
What's the current status-quo on setting `safeBlockHash`? LH has it set to the head block, as per some old specifications.

My understanding is that the "safe head" was something that the research team *thought* they had figured out but then it turned to be more complex than originally considered.

My feeling is that if we're communicating something to be "safe" and we don't have a definition of what "safe" means, then we should use the finalized checkpoint. cc <@425572898787426305>

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: the latest spec specifies to use justified checkpoint: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2858

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: The status quo is to use justified as a safe block as its quite safe from re-orgs and is used as initial checkpoint for the safe algorithm that we have. Once the algorithm is improved we will upgrade `get_safe_beacon_block_root` function to return a block that is closer to the head
